subject: chemistry
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: How does the reactivity of the Group 1 alkali metals change going down the group?
questions.explain: Reactivity increases down Group 1 as the outer electron is more easily lost.

questions.q: How is the mass number of an atom calculated?
questions.explain: Mass number is the total number of protons and neutrons.

questions.q: Which of these is a compound?
options: A mixture of salt and sand
questions.explain: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen chemically bonded together.

options: Chlorine displaces bromine from sodium bromide
Bromine displaces chlorine from sodium chloride
Iodine displaces chlorine from sodium chloride
Chlorine displaces fluorine from sodium fluoride
questions.explain: A more reactive halogen (chlorine) displaces a less reactive one (bromine) from its salt.

questions.q: Isotopes of the same element have the same number of protons but different numbers of:
questions.explain: Isotopes differ only in their number of neutrons.

questions.q: An atom of sodium has 11 protons and 12 neutrons. How many electrons does it have?
questions.explain: A neutral atom has equal numbers of protons and electrons, so 11 electrons.

questions.q: A period in the periodic table is a:
questions.explain: A period is a horizontal row; elements across a period gain electrons in the same shell.

questions.q: In which group are the alkali metals found?
questions.explain: The alkali metals are the elements of Group 1.

questions.q: What is the relative charge of a proton?
questions.explain: Protons carry a relative charge of +1.

questions.q: What is the electronic structure of a neutral chlorine atom (17 electrons)?
questions.explain: Filling shells 2 then 8 then 7 gives 2,8,7 for 17 electrons.

questions.q: Where are non-metals generally found in the periodic table?
questions.explain: Non-metals are located on the right-hand side of the periodic table.
